Preserve which values came from the outer invocation during enrichment so outer raw entries beat inner typed values while outer typed values still beat inner raw entries.

For callers that enrich before finishing, setting `input_tokens = 10`, calling `enrich_from_context(...)`, then setting `input_tokens = 20` leaves the span reporting 10 while the token metric reports 20. The base revision reports 20 consistently. Could we preserve outer precedence without freezing these values, and cover this sequence in a regression test?

threads.body: Renaming `enrich_from_context` on the exported inference, embedding, retrieval, and fetch-response invocation classes makes existing callers raise `AttributeError`. Retain deprecated forwarding methods in all four classes, following the [API compatibility rule](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/util/opentelemetry-util-genai/AGENTS.md#8-python-api-conventions). If removal is intentional, the PR must instead document which released instrumentations were checked in this repository and `opentelemetry-python-contrib`, as required by the [compatibility assessment rule](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/.github/instructions/util-genai.instructions.md#3-api-backwards-compatibility).
